reference.title: DBE IT CAPS 2024 · Section 3 amendment
reference.scope: Curriculum reference, not formal approval. Page numbers are PDF pages of the amendment. Original pseudocode/JavaScript/SQLite examples supplement the school language and DBMS; they do not replace the CAPS Delphi practical.
